import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "e71260f973e45da941535d526fd4e4b01477f7e2"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/cdp.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/cli.py",
]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(k in line for k in [
            "__all__", "def close_target", "def evaluate", "def click",
            "def project_record", "def active_projects", "def main",
            "add_parser(", "browser_parser", "def _page_contains",
            "def _bootstrap_prompt", "_owned_chat_registry_path",
            "_rollover_transaction_path"
        ]):
            start=max(1,i-8); end=min(len(lines),i+35)
            print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
            for n in range(start,end+1):
                print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")

home=Path.home()/".do_again"
ids=[
"6ac69a7a-6fe8-83e8-b3f4-6f0c333df723",
"6ac69ad4-6524-83e8-827f-d1f93b18f5dd",
"6ac69ba8-fe28-83e8-aee5-87a87a77258a",
"6ac69bd2-b3d0-83e8-9747-9cc5ed3516ef",
]
print("=== candidate corroborating receipt summaries ===")
for cid in ids:
    rows=[]
    for path in sorted((home/"projects/41857a676462/control/automation/do_again/receipts").glob("*.json")):
        try: data=json.loads(path.read_text())
        except Exception: continue
        blob=json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True)
        if cid in blob:
            rows.append({
                "file":path.name,
                "request_id":data.get("request_id"),
                "state":data.get("state"),
                "operation":data.get("operation"),
                "result_keys": sorted((data.get("result") or {}).keys()) if isinstance(data.get("result"),dict) else [],
            })
    print(cid, json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True))
